posts.title: The Isle of Dread Reimagined
posts.description: When I was a 15-year-old gamer, I loved the D&D "Blue Box" Expert Set. Now our D&D games were free from the narrow confines of the dungeon! Into the wilderness! Horses, castles, armies, hex maps! Plus a bunch of boring travel rules. posts.title: Perilous Tales of the Garbage Barge
posts.description: There's a great RPG called 'You Got A Job On The Garbage Barge' by the esteemed indie game designer Amanda Lee Franck . It's a lightweight game set on a gigantic floating post-apocalyptic garbage barge. It's weird and punk rock and I recommend picking up a copy.
